answer: The forge index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an farming party to the back of the vault queue while genuine members promoted earlier continues earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 961 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the wharf. A farm of 77 pays that 158 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
